trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller-supplied (possibly untrusted) URL/path string gets local environment variables and ~ expanded into it before it goes into a git command line or a config file; decided in Git.polish_url (and its Cygwin twin cygpath/_cygexpath), which expands unconditionally.

landing_point.why: The summary names Repo.create_remote()/Remote.add(); Remote.create calls Git.polish_url(url) right before `git remote add`, and Repo.create_remote just delegates to it (git/repo/base.py:661).

fix_sites.entry_point: Git.polish_url (public classmethod; reached by every route below)

fix_sites.module_kind: low-level util, Cygwin-only second implementation of expansion
low-level util, recursive parser dispatch (file: recursion, drive parsers)

fix_sites.entry_point: Remote.create / Remote.add / Repo.create_remote; also RootModule.update URL-change path (git/objects/submodule/root.py:275)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: git/util.py:385-434 (cygpath/_cygexpath, Cygwin-only expansion reached from git/cmd.py:923-924)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The Cygwin branch is platform-specific, its own comment says 'maybe a remote system should expand vars' (git/util.py:394), its docstring tells callers to use polish_url instead (git/util.py:420), and it cannot be reproduced on Linux/macOS, so a solver who patches the non-Cygwin branch of polish_url can argue Cygwin is out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Git.polish_url must keep its default expansion and backslash-to-slash normalisation for trusted local paths (public API used widely, e.g. separate_git_dir and test helpers), and Repo(path)/Repo.init still expand env vars by default on purpose. An over-broad fix that drops expansion from polish_url globally, removes polish_url from clone/remote paths, or rejects URLs containing '$'/'%' breaks Windows path normalisation and legitimate URLs containing literal '$'.

O6_input_shapes: %VAR% (Windows expandvars; listed in fix test fix.diff:238)
Cygwin drive paths C:\... and \\?\C:\... through _cygexpath (git/util.py:412-413)
file: URLs re-parsed recursively by cygpath (git/util.py:414, 428-429)
a URL that expands into ext::... and so slips past check_unsafe_protocols run on the raw string (git/repo/base.py:1455-1468; fix.diff:142-145, 258-264)

O7_producer.where: Submodule URL read from the committed .gitmodules (sm.url) flows into Remote.create at git/objects/submodule/root.py:275 and into clone_from via git/objects/submodule/base.py:803-807 -> 362; the stored origin URL is re-read from config and rewritten at git/repo/base.py:1508

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Repo._clone still runs Git.polish_url(sep_dir) with default expansion on the separate_git_dir kwarg, which Submodule._clone_repo fills from a path built from the submodule name
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is a local directory path option, not a URL; expansion of local paths is a documented convenience (Repo(path) keeps expand_vars=True by default).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same function as the clone fix; producer in git/objects/submodule/base.py:307,351

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Cygwin + bare clone runs Git.polish_url(path) with default expansion on the destination path
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Cygwin-only workaround for a git bug, and it is a destination path, not a URL.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same function as the clone fix

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Repo.__init__ calls cygpath(epath) unconditionally on Cygwin before the expand_vars gate, so Repo(path, expand_vars=False) still expands variables there (the prior advisory's own opt-out)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It belongs to the earlier advisory GHSA-rwj8-pgh3-r573 / Repo constructor, it is Cygwin-only, and it is a local path.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: find_submodule_git_dir passes the contents of a .git file ('gitdir: ...') through cygpath with default expansion on Cygwin
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Cygwin-only filesystem lookup with no URL and nothing written out, so it looks like a different feature.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: git/repo/fun.py, a separate module from the report's remote/clone path

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Remote.set_url / add_url could normalise new_url through Git.polish_url like Remote.create does (it currently does not, so it has no expansion).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer wanting set-url to match create's Windows-backslash fix (#525) would naturally copy the polish_url call; that would make it a distant twin route into the same sink.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Submodule.update writes self.url to the parent config; wrapping it in Git.polish_url to match Submodule.add (git/objects/submodule/base.py:610) would add a .gitmodules-sourced expansion route.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Submodule.add already polishes before an identical config write, so making update consistent is a plausible cleanup.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The relative ('../') URL join in _clone_repo could pass the joined URL through Git.polish_url to normalise Windows separators from os.path.join.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: os.path.join produces backslashes on Windows, which is exactly what polish_url exists to fix.

O9_family: information exposure: environment-variable expansion of untrusted URL strings into git command arguments/config (CWE-200/CWE-214), plus a check-before-transform ordering flaw on the unsafe-protocol check

O10_build.toolchain: pip install -e . plus the test extras (pytest); needs a system git binary and the gitdb/smmap dependencies
O10_build.project_tests: test/test_remote.py, test/test_clone.py, test/test_submodule.py, test/test_util.py (cygpath tables at test/test_util.py:337-366); Cygwin behaviour is testable via polish_url(is_cygwin=True) without Cygwin

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Remove os.path.expandvars from the non-Cygwin branch of polish_url (or only at Remote.create), leaving the Cygwin cygpath/_cygexpath expansion, the post-clone config rewrite and the check-before-expand ordering in _clone untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: git/config.py:579 and git/config.py:663 expanduser path-typed config values and include paths (~ only, no env vars); this is git-config semantics, not this advisory.
Repo.init/Repo.__init__ default expand_vars=True (git/repo/base.py:192, 1380) is the earlier advisory's documented deprecated behaviour.
unverified: Repo size in MB was not measured (no shell). The git/ package is 37 .py files, so tiny_repo (<5 MB source) probably holds but is not flagged without a measurement.
